# Mini Markdown Policy

Document ID: mini-md · Owner: People Operations · Effective 2026-01-01 · Version 2026.1
Topics: pto, holidays

## Purpose and Scope

This miniature document exercises the Markdown parsing path. It is not a policy and nothing in it is
true of Mosaic Robotics; it exists so a parser test never has to load the fourteen real documents.

## Accrual

### Standard Accrual Rates

Full-time employees accrue nine days of imaginary time off per month in this fixture. The rate is
stated once and never restated, so a test can assert that a quote survives parsing unchanged. The
paragraph continues at length because this leaf section has to exceed the maximum chunk size before
the windowing branch of the chunker is reached at all. Every sentence here ends with a full stop so
that the sentence-boundary split has somewhere obvious to cut. A leaf that is shorter than the
maximum is emitted whole, which is the branch the neighbouring subsection covers. A leaf that is
longer is cut into an ordered list of windows that share one heading path, and consecutive windows
overlap by the configured number of characters so that a sentence straddling a cut is still findable
from either side. The overlap is what a retrieval system needs when the answer to a question sits
exactly on a boundary. Without it the boundary is a hole. With it the boundary is merely a seam, and
a seam costs nothing but a little duplicated text in two neighbouring chunks. This fixture therefore
keeps talking until it is comfortably past the fourteen hundred character threshold, and then keeps
talking a little longer so that the second window is itself substantial rather than a sliver. A
sliver would be dropped by the minimum-size floor, and a test that never produced one would not be
testing the floor. The final sentence of this section says nothing new and exists only to make the
character count land where the test needs it.

### Carryover

Employees may carry over two imaginary days. Anything above that expires on the last day of March.

## Questions

Ask the fixture. It does not answer.
